# Refresher Reminder

> Enter your last HAZWOPER certificate date and get your refresher due date, plus a calendar reminder (.ics or Google Calendar) 30 days ahead. Then renew online.

Refresher Reminder (https://refresher-reminder.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 8-Hour Refresher, Supervisor Refresher, Responder Refresher, TSD Refresher or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://refresher-reminder.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Guides

- [Keeping a whole crew on one renewal date](https://refresher-reminder.hazwoperosha.us/guides/keeping-a-crew-on-one-renewal-date): Staggered certificates mean somebody is always about to lapse. How to line everyone up.
- [What starts the 12-month refresher clock?](https://refresher-reminder.hazwoperosha.us/guides/what-counts-as-the-12-month-clock): The date on your last certificate, initial or refresher. A few common questions answered.
